stories.title: Moncloa pide al jurado del caso Begoña Gómez que corrija a los jueces e «imparta justicia»

en.title: Moncloa asks jury in Begoña Gómez case to correct judges and "administer justice"
en.summary: The Spanish government has condemned a judge's decision to open oral proceedings against Begoña Gómez, the wife of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. Socialist sources claim she has been subject to political and judicial persecution for two years.

stories.title: Zapatero tiene tres días para justificar sus joyas y sus hijas declararán en noviembre como imputadas

en.title: Zapatero has three days to justify his jewels and his daughters will testify in November as accused
en.summary: A judge in the Plus Ultra case has given former President José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero three days to provide documentation about jewels seized from his Madrid office, valued at 1.3 million euros. His daughters are scheduled to testify as accused parties in November.

stories.title: El juez Juan Carlos Peinado envía a Begoña Gómez a juicio con jurado por tráfico de influencias y malversación

en.title: Judge Juan Carlos Peinado sends Begoña Gómez to trial with jury for influence peddling and embezzlement
en.summary: A judge has ordered jury trial proceedings against Begoña Gómez, spouse of the Prime Minister, on charges of influence peddling and embezzlement. Her La Moncloa adviser Cristina Álvarez is also included in the proceedings for involvement in unauthorized use of university software.

stories.title: Feijóo y Vivas, ante el PP europeo: «El Gobierno mira para otro lado en Ceuta»

en.title: Feijóo and Vivas, before European PP: "The Government looks the other way in Ceuta"
en.summary: Spanish opposition leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo visited Ceuta with a European People's Party delegation headed by German politician Manfred Weber. They met with the city's president to assess the severe migrant situation that has developed following unrest in late July.

stories.title: El juez Peinado abre juicio con jurado a Begoña Gómez por delitos de tráfico de influencias y malversación

en.title: Judge Peinado opens jury trial against Begoña Gómez for influence peddling and embezzlement
en.summary: A Spanish judge has sent the wife of the government president to trial with a jury on charges of influence trafficking and misappropriation of funds, after revising his investigation following corrections from Madrid's Provincial Court.

stories.title: El juez cita como investigadas a las hijas de Zapatero el 30 de noviembre y pide un nuevo informe sobre las joyas millonarias del ex presidente

en.title: Judge summons Zapatero's daughters as investigated parties on November 30 and requests new report on former president's millionaire jewels
en.summary: A judge has called the former president's daughters as investigated parties and requested a new report regarding valuable jewels belonging to the ex-president, asking his legal team to provide all related documentation within three days.

stories.title: El Gobierno denuncia la “intención política” del juez Peinado en la causa contra Begoña Gómez

en.title: Government denounces "political intention" of judge Peinado in case against Begoña Gómez
en.summary: The Spanish government and Socialist Party leadership have condemned what they characterize as judicial persecution and defended the innocence of the president's wife in the case brought by judge Peinado.

stories.title: Moncloa denuncia una "persecución judicial" contra Begoña Gómez y acusa a Peinado de "acoso", mientras el PP se frota las manos: "No hay banquillo para tanto acusado cercano a Sánchez"

en.title: Moncloa denounces "judicial persecution" against Begoña Gómez and accuses Peinado of "harassment", while PP celebrates: "There is no bench for so many accused close to Sánchez"
en.summary: The government characterizes the case as political persecution and accuses the judge of harassment, while the main opposition party suggests a broader judicial pursuit against officials associated with the president.

stories.title: El Gobierno “condena” la “persecución judicial” a Begoña Gómez tras la decisión de apertura de juicio oral

en.title: Government "condemns" "judicial persecution" of Begoña Gómez after oral trial opening decision
en.summary: The Spanish government has criticized judge Peinado and characterized the legal proceedings against the president's wife as arbitrary and unjust following the decision to open an oral trial.

stories.title: El juez da tres días a Zapatero para que aclare el origen de las joyas

en.title: Judge gives Zapatero three days to clarify the origin of jewels
en.summary: A judge has ordered a new expert report on jewelry items and scheduled Zapatero's daughters to appear as investigated persons on November 30th.

stories.title: Consulte el auto del juez Peinado con el que abre juicio oral a Begoña Gómez

en.title: Consult judge Peinado's order opening oral trial against Begoña Gómez
en.summary: Judge Peinado has sent the president's wife to trial on charges of influence peddling and embezzlement.

stories.title: Peinado envía a Begoña Gómez a juicio con jurado por malversación y tráfico de influencias

en.title: Peinado sends Begoña Gómez to jury trial for embezzlement and influence peddling
en.summary: Begoña Gómez faces jury trial on embezzlement and influence peddling charges, with the Complutense University claiming 113,000 euros in damages.

stories.title: Santander ficha al director general de la 'fintech' del exCEO de BBVA Ángel Cano

en.title: Santander hires general director of fintech from former BBVA CEO Ángel Cano
en.summary: Luis Cantero has joined Santander's global Data and Artificial Intelligence unit. The executive previously worked at a fintech company associated with former BBVA CEO Ángel Cano.

stories.title: Paramount sella un litigio en EEUU y allana la megacompra de Warner Bros

en.title: Paramount settles litigation in USA and clears the way for Warner Bros megapurchase
en.summary: Paramount reached an agreement with prosecutors from multiple U.S. states who had sued to block its acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery. The deal removes a major regulatory obstacle for the 110 billion dollar transaction.

stories.title: Arabia Saudí lanza su propia marca de coches eléctricos para reducir su dependencia del petróleo

en.title: Saudi Arabia launches its own electric car brand to reduce oil dependency
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has introduced its own electric vehicle brand as part of efforts to diversify its economy and reduce reliance on petroleum.

stories.title: El Ibex celebra la caída del petróleo y supera los 19.700 puntos

en.title: The Ibex celebrates oil's fall and surpasses 19,700 points
en.summary: The Ibex 35 started the week at 19,513 points after declining 1.60% in Friday's session, with lower oil prices supporting the index.

stories.title: Self Bank lanza un depósito a dos años al 2,75% TAE

en.title: Self Bank launches a two-year deposit at 2.75% APY
en.summary: Self Bank is introducing a 24-month deposit product offering 2.75% annual percentage yield with monthly interest payments, competing with other high-yield savings accounts available in Spain.
